scope: Small repository-owned command contract, not an ECC/Codex schema or whole-repository safety certification. Only auditAllowed commands with unchanged reviewed inputs can be selected. Omitted commands always require review. Denied entries intentionally do not certify delegated helpers.

dev.reason: Starts the local application with fresh isolated build output. The pre-hook may generate Prisma Client; application requests can access configured services. Not a read-only audit command.

dev:turbopack.reason: Starts the local application with Turbopack and fresh isolated build output. The pre-hook may generate Prisma Client; application requests can access configured services. Not a read-only audit command.

test:dev:startup.reason: Node tests create/remove only owned OS temporary fixtures and exercise Next config with mocked Webpack inputs. No application startup, environment-file loading, Prisma preparation, database or network requests.

agent:workflow:check.reason: Read-only manifest/reference/hash validation. Does not execute selected commands, load environment files, or contact services.

agent:workflow:test.reason: Isolated Node Jest fixture tests. Creates and removes only its OS temporary fixtures; no application setup, database, or network. Uses installed Jest.

build.script: npm run release:secrets:preflight && npm run build:linted
build.reason: Validates release secrets and builds application output; loads application configuration. No schema promotion. Not a read-only audit.

verify:ci.script: npm run ci:release:gate && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy && npm run prisma:migration:history:health && npm run prisma:migrate:status && npm run verify:repo
verify:ci.reason: Includes migration deploy, migration history/database checks, build and broad tests. Prohibited for read-only audits.

prisma:migrate:deploy.reason: Changes the configured database schema. Requires explicit reviewed target and release workflow.

prisma:migrate:deploy:safe.reason: Executes migration gate/deployment and writes evidence. A safety gate does not make deployment read-only.

seed:e2e:payroll.reason: Writes database fixture users. Requires an explicitly disposable target.

test:purchase-receiving:postgres.reason: Drops/recreates a local certification schema, runs db push and migration SQL, executes database tests and drops schema. Requires reviewed disposable target.

payroll:trust-spine:postgres.reason: Prepares/resets a test database before PostgreSQL certification and writes evidence. Requires reviewed disposable target.

test:ecc:pilots.reason: Bounded mocked-unit/jsdom and static-source pilot suites. Uses installed Next/SWC/Jest and generated Prisma; nextJest without dir avoids application Next config, dotenv and tsconfig loading. Existing setup mocks persistence. Temporary Jest filesystem work is possible; no database/network intended. Application import changes still require review.

release:artifact.reason: Builds application and writes a new standalone artifact with source/content digests. Requires isolated build environment.

release:artifact:verify.reason: Reads artifact/source files and validates digests; requires explicit artifact path and trusted digest; not a generic audit lane.

release:schema:promote.reason: Mutating target-bound migration stage; verifies trusted artifact digest and existing secret/migration gates under a database advisory lock.
